voice.name: Test Voice
voice.basis: The established FGW narration voice (same voice id as Infrared Contacts, Living Skin and Hidden Trigger V3-V7). Re-confirmed with creative_list_voices on 23 Oct 2026. No Death Clock voice record exists in this repository, so it was not matched to Death Clock specifically.

prompts.A: [curious, brisk, restrained tension] If you raised this shield, someone looking straight at you could watch your body DISAPPEAR. [light, conversational] You see, its surface is covered in tiny lenses. [brisk, flowing] They spread the light coming from your body SIDEWAYS, while smearing the background across the space where you're standing. From the right position, your outline disappears into a blurred patch of scenery. [leaning in, playful] So you could reach one hand around the edge… and make it look like a hand is FLOATING IN MIDAIR. [quietly knowing] Then lower the shield… and reveal you were standing right in front of them THE ENTIRE TIME.
prompts.B: [curious, brisk, crisp consonants] If you raised THIS shield, someone looking straight at you could watch your body DISAPPEAR. [light, conversational] You see, its surface is covered in tiny lenses. [brisk, flowing] They spread the light coming from your body SIDEWAYS, while smearing the background across the space where you're standing. From the right position, your outline disappears into a blurred patch of scenery. [leaning in, playful] So you could reach one hand around the edge… and make it look like a hand is FLOATING IN MIDAIR. [quietly knowing] Then lower the shield… and reveal you were standing right in front of them THE ENTIRE TIME.

note_on_prompt: Bracketed tags are delivery directions (not spoken); capitals are emphasis. The spoken words are exactly the approved narration (production/NARRATION_APPROVED.txt).

selected.why: Speech starts at 0.05 s (frame 0), 195 wpm over the speech span, short ellipsis beats (0.40 s after "edge", 0.35 s after "shield"), a connected opening phrase, and the cleanest independent transcript. Take 4 had a likely doubled "the" before "edge" in the Vosk transcript; takes 1-2 were equivalent but prompt B asked for crisper consonants on the opening.

verification.independent_asr: Vosk vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 (free recognition) and PocketSphinx en-us; both local. All four takes are heard by both recognisers as "raise the shield" for "raised this shield": a systematic small-model / language-model bias on the elided "-d th-" that a listener must confirm. Remaining Vosk differences on the selected take are spelling-only (its/it's, midair/mid air, then/than).
verification.elevenlabs_scribe: An ElevenLabs Scribe transcription of the takes returned the generation prompt verbatim (including the bracketed tags), so it is not an independent check and was not used.
verification.not_done: Nobody has listened to the takes. This environment has no audio output.

edits: None: the selected take is used unedited (no cuts, inserted pauses, time-stretch, pitch or EQ). A 0.66 s silent tail is appended after the last word.
